meta.title: Services
meta.description: We build the intelligent layer that wires AI into sales, ops, customer service, and development — and keeps it all running.

hero.headline: AI wired into every layer of your business.
hero.subline: We're not a single automation tool. We build the intelligent layer that wires AI into sales, ops, customer service, and development — and keeps it all running.

automation.title: AI automation and agents
automation.body: We set up agents that run in the background, talk to your tools (Tripletex, Fiken, Shopify, Slack), and do the work without anyone lifting a finger.

strategy.title: AI strategy and advisory
strategy.body: A couple of workshops, a prioritised list of what is actually worth automating, and a plan you can work from. No slide decks.

implementation.title: AI implementation
implementation.body: We build and ship one concrete workflow end to end. Fixed price, fixed scope, and a runbook you own after handover.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.body: We walk through your processes, find what is grinding, and score every candidate on hours saved per month.

strategy.title: Strategy
strategy.body: We pick the one workflow that pays back the most first, and write a clear scope with acceptance criteria.

build.title: Build
build.body: We build the agent in your environment, connect it to the tools you already use, and test against real data.

followup.title: Follow-up
followup.body: Two weeks of close support after launch. After that you can take it over yourself, or we can run it on retainer.

hours.label: per week
hours.body: Average across three pilots, measured against baseline before the agent ran.

throughput.label: more cases handled
throughput.body: Same team, three times the inbound resolved within the same day.

errors.label: fewer errors
errors.body: Fewer typos, fewer forgotten tasks, fewer chase emails from clients.

speed.label: from kickoff to live
speed.body: Median for a pilot. We have done it in 11, we have spent 25, it scales with scope.

pricing.headline: Pick the smallest door.
pricing.subline: Three tiers. No open retainers. No surprise invoices.

discovery.name: Discovery Sprint
discovery.pitch: Map three to five candidate workflows, score them by hours saved, leave with a prioritised roadmap.
discovery.detail: Two workshops. If you go ahead with a pilot within 30 days, the Sprint fee is credited in full.

pilot.name: Implementation Pilot
pilot.pitch: Build and ship one production workflow end to end.
pilot.detail: You walk away with an agent live in your environment, a runbook, and two weeks of post-launch support. Fixed scope, fixed price.

retainer.name: Agent Ops Retainer
retainer.pitch: Maintain the agents, add new workflows, monthly optimisation review.
retainer.detail: Available after a successful pilot. Monthly report on what ran, what failed, what we tuned.

safety.a: Every agent we ship has bounded scope, approval gates on anything outbound (emails, invoices, payments), and full audit logs. You sign off on the policy before the agent goes live.

messy.a: That is what the Discovery Sprint is for. We scope what is doable now versus what needs cleanup first, and we price both.

waiting.q: We are waiting for ChatGPT Enterprise or Copilot.
waiting.a: Those are chat assistants, they answer when someone opens them. We install workflows: agents that run in the background as part of operations.

ownership.q: Who owns the agent after launch?
ownership.a: You do. It runs on your account, against your tools, on your data. If we walk away tomorrow, it keeps running.

team.a: A small Norwegian team in Bergen, supervised by an accountable principal. We take a limited number of engagements per quarter.

languages.a: Yes. We explicitly test on Norwegian documents, emails, and customer data, not just English.

industries.a: Most of our delivery has been in accounting, law, and e-commerce. The common thread: many small repetitive tasks with clear rules.

starting.a: A 30-minute call. We ask what is grinding, you tell us, and we say honestly whether an agent is the right shape for the problem.

ctaBanner.subline: 30 minutes on a call. We scope the problem and tell you honestly whether this is the right path.

meta.title: Use cases
meta.description: AI OS in practice: four concrete use cases showing how Crunchtime wires AI into websites, customer ops, development, and operational visibility.

hero.headline: AI OS in practice.
hero.subline: Four concrete use cases showing how we wire AI into the sales surface, customer pipeline, development loop, and ops view — without asking your team to build a new operating system from scratch.

grid.headline: What it looks like when AI becomes part of operations.
grid.subline: Three cards show capabilities we can install across your business. One card shows a named client already running the model live.

website.title: Dynamic AI website
website.summary: The site adapts to each visitor — personalised content, contextual messaging, and AI agents that act on buying signals automatically. When someone shows intent, the system qualifies the lead, triggers an outreach sequence, and books a meeting without anyone touching a keyboard. Your website stops being a brochure and becomes the most active sales rep on your team.

ops.title: Automated customer ops
ops.summary: A customer registers, and the system takes it from there. Personalised email sequences, automatic booking links, smart follow-ups, and re-engagement triggers — all without a human in the loop. Your team handles relationships; the AI handles the pipeline. Zero dropped leads, zero manual steps between a new registration and a booked first meeting. It runs the same way at 9 AM and 11 PM.

dev.title: AI development pipeline
dev.summary: Fjordbyte runs its entire software development lifecycle through Paperclip — an AI-native project layer where agents plan, write, review, and ship code, with humans in the loop only for high-leverage decisions. Smaller teams move faster, quality gates run automatically, and senior engineers spend their time on architecture rather than admin. Live proof that a software company can be operated as an AI OS.

intelligence.title: AI-powered ops intelligence
intelligence.summary: Your financial, sales, and operational data connected to an AI layer that surfaces what matters. Natural language queries replace manual reports, anomaly alerts replace weekly check-ins, and forecasts replace guesswork. We wire your existing tools — Tripletex, Fiken, Shopify, HubSpot — into a single AI-powered ops view. Your team spends time acting on decisions, not pulling the numbers to make them.
